previousGoalTurnClassification: progress: authorized v19 goal/entrypoint maintenance committed0753cac; not a model iteration or appearance gain

milestone.decision: Retain the integrated complete appearance gain but change the broader dependency to controllable complete body/head and real scalp following. No additional style variants or point-only wrap repair chain.
milestone.nextAction: Use the saved complete r68C appearance-study woman as the active authoring study, preserving r65 as the last scoped verified ocular/anatomy foundation. Stop new hairstyle, wrap-stage and root-offset variants. Change the next production dependency to usable body/head controls plus actual scalp/guide following on this same complete woman. The original CC0 char.blend was independently inspected and has NO armature, only two vertex groups; do not claim its embedded UI is a rig. The pinned CharMorph-Vitruvian config declares separate rigs.blend, bones.yaml, weights and joints; inspect/fetch those exact pinned CC0 data with bounded preflight before transferring source-indexed weights, without installing an addon or executing embedded code. First usable endpoint is actual controlled head motion with the retained full hairstyle attached, then independent body poses; require a real complete-head/body motion clip, not static groups. This establishes control/attachment only, not natural hair dynamics or contact. Keep finite curved shafts, root joins, hair self/body/cloth and continuous motion unaccepted until proved. No more isolated solver/tool-only mainline. Full face/skin/oral/body/cloth/rig, natural hair motion, real Aevrynd import/material/LOD/performance and explicit female acceptance remain mandatory.
